title: HARM: Learning Hate-Aware Reward Model for Evaluating Natural Language Explanations of Offensive Content
authors_zh: Lorenzo Puppi Vecchi, Alceu de Souza Britto Jr, Emerson Cabrera Paraiso, Rafael Menelau Cruz
paper_type_zh: 判断、rubric 或领域专家数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要构建或审计 LLM-as-a-judge、奖励模型与专家评测数据的研究者。
one_line: A human-validated explanation dataset and reward-model setup for audit of offensive-content explanations.
以分层人工语境重校奖励信号，避免仇恨言论解释因必要的冒犯措辞而被错误降分。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General reward models often reward sanitized hate-speech explanations, even when mentioning a stereotype or harmful wording is necessary to explain why the source text is offensive. This makes the score disagree with explanatory fidelity and can train or select evasive explanations.

HARM studies this mismatch using controlled natural-language explanations with progressively richer human context, then builds a hate-aware reward model that reweights interpretable reward signals for this domain.

通用奖励模型常偏好经过净化的仇恨言论解释；但要说明原文为何具有冒犯性，往往必须提到刻板印象或有害措辞。于是奖励分数会与解释忠实性相背离，进而让训练或筛选过程偏向回避性解释。

HARM 用含不同层次人工语境的自然语言解释检验这种错配，并构建面向仇恨解释的奖励模型，以可解释的奖励信号重新加权。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: HARM combines SBIC-Explain, a human-validated set of 370,788 LLM-generated NLEs, with a mixture-of-experts reward head. The data exposes three context tiers: text only, classification-aware, and semantics-informed. HARM learns to favor the richer explanation when the added context improves fidelity rather than treating offensive language itself as a defect. The authors release code; the archival dataset license should be checked before redistribution.
HARM 将 SBIC-Explain 与混合专家奖励头结合。SBIC-Explain 含 370,788 条经人工验证、由 LLM 生成的自然语言解释，并提供仅文本、知晓分类、知晓语义三种语境层级。只要补充语境确实提高解释忠实性，HARM 就应偏好信息更丰富的解释，而非把冒犯性语言本身当作缺陷。作者公开代码；重新分发前仍应核验归档数据许可证。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Starting from human-annotated SBIC records, LLMs generate NLEs with text only, then with classification labels, then with stereotype-aware semantic context.
  1. Human annotators compare tier pairs to test whether richer context is perceived as more faithful. Generic reward models and LLM judges score the same pairs to reveal a preference for sanitized language.
  1. HARM uses ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 with a gated mixture of interpretable attributes; MOE-Off additionally supervises the gate with offensiveness annotations. The reported optimizer is Adam with learning rate 0.0025. Fix data split, prompts, backbone, and repository revision when reproducing.

1. 作者从带人工标注的 SBIC 记录出发，让 LLM 分别仅看文本、再看分类标签、最后看刻板印象等语义语境，生成自然语言解释。
  1. 人工标注者比较不同层级的解释，以检验更丰富语境是否提高忠实性；通用奖励模型和 LLM 评审对同一回答对打分，从而暴露其对净化语言的偏好。
  1. HARM 以 ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 为骨干，用门控混合专家组合可解释属性；MOE-Off 还以冒犯性标注监督门控。论文报告 Adam、学习率 0.0025。复现必须固定数据划分、提示词、骨干模型和仓库版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The decisive comparison is tier-pair accuracy on SBIC-Explain (Table 2). For Tier 3 over Tier 2, ArmoRM scores 0.28 and URM scores 0.23, whereas HARM MOE-Off scores 0.79; for Tier 3 over Tier 1, HARM scores 0.87. This directly tests the stated directional preference, not broad content safety.

It supports that HARM reproduces the study's context-richness signal better than the chosen baselines. It cannot prove that every offensive explanation is accurate, safe, or preferable without human review of its source context.

决定性比较是 SBIC-Explain 上的层级回答对准确率（表 2）。在“第三层优于第二层”上，ArmoRM 为 0.28、URM 为 0.23，而 HARM MOE-Off 为 0.79；在“第三层优于第一层”上，HARM 为 0.87。该设置直接测试所主张的层级偏好，而非广义内容安全。

结果支持 HARM 比所选基线更能复现研究中的语境丰富度信号；它不能证明每一条含冒犯措辞的解释都准确、安全或应被优先采用，仍须人工复核原始语境。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Generic RMs assess broad helpfulness and safety, so they may penalize language needed to explain a stereotype. HARM changes the reward contract from generic preference to a tiered, human-validated fidelity signal for offensive-content explanations. Its novelty is the controlled tier construction plus interpretable, offensiveness-aware expert mixing, not merely applying a larger reward backbone.
通用奖励模型衡量宽泛的帮助性和安全性，因而可能惩罚解释刻板印象所必需的语言。HARM 将奖励契约从通用偏好改为面向冒犯内容解释、经人工验证的分层忠实性信号。其新意是受控的层级构造与可解释、知晓冒犯性的专家混合，而不是单纯换用更大的奖励骨干。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The tier ordering is a directional proxy for explanatory fidelity, not a universal ranking rule. More explicit offensive language can be warranted in one context and harmful or inaccurate in another; deployment therefore needs human escalation and source-context checks.

The data is grounded in SBIC and English hate-speech explanations. Results may not transfer to other languages, policies, or moderation definitions. Before training on the release, verify dataset terms and audit whether the learned gate amplifies protected-group stereotypes.

层级排序只是解释忠实性的方向性代理，并非普遍排序规则。同样的冒犯措辞在某些语境中是必要解释，在另一些语境中却可能有害或失实；部署时仍需人工升级处理和原始语境检查。

数据基于 SBIC 与英语仇恨言论解释，未必迁移到其他语言、政策或审核定义。训练前应核验数据条款，并审计学习到的门控是否放大了受保护群体刻板印象。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the dataset and tier protocol to audit whether a moderation explanation scorer suppresses necessary context. Input a labeled harmful-content record and candidate explanations, score them by tier-aware fidelity, and output an audit report or a reward-model comparison.

Use HARM only with a documented human-review path and the same sensitive-content policy. Do not use it as an automatic moderation decision or as proof that an explanation is factually correct.

可用该数据和分层协议审计审核解释评分器是否压制了必要语境：输入带标签的有害内容记录与候选解释，按层级感知的忠实性评分，输出审计报告或奖励模型比较结果。

HARM 只能配合明确的人类复核路径和同一敏感内容政策使用，不能作为自动审核决策，也不能证明一段解释在事实层面正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: HARM audits a reward-model failure in hate-speech explanations: safety-oriented scores can punish explanatory fidelity.
  • Method: SBIC-Explain varies available human context across three tiers; HARM reweights interpretable reward attributes with a gated expert head.
  • Artifact: SBIC-Explain contains 370,788 LLM-generated NLEs; the authors provide code, while data terms require verification.
  • Evidence: for Tier 3 over Tier 2, HARM MOE-Off reaches 0.79 versus 0.28 for ArmoRM.
  • Reuse decision: use for human-supervised explanation auditing; first inspect licensing and test stereotype amplification on the target policy.

• 定位：HARM 审计仇恨言论解释中的奖励失效：安全取向评分可能惩罚解释忠实性。
  • 方法抓手：SBIC-Explain 以三层人工语境生成解释；HARM 用门控专家头重加权可解释奖励属性。
  • 数据抓手：SBIC-Explain 含 370,788 条 LLM 生成解释；作者公开代码，数据条款仍须核验。
  • 证据锚点：“第三层优于第二层”上，HARM MOE-Off 为 0.79，ArmoRM 为 0.28。
  • 复用决定：适合有人类监督的解释审计；先检查许可证，并在目标政策上测试刻板印象放大风险。
